Pete Crow-Armstrong has 40 home runs and 38 stolen bases.

He needs 2 steals in 5 games to join Canseco, Bonds, A-Rod, Soriano, Acuña, and Ohtani in the 40-40 club.

No Cub has ever done it. The window is open. ⚾
